html.login.help:
Enter the PIN shown on the tablet in
Media Home › Settings › Web remote.
html.hint.access: Tip: to see what's playing and seek, allow Notification access for Media Home on the tablet (Media Home › Settings › Web remote).
html.hint.launch: Tip: to open apps from here, allow Display over other apps for Media Home on the tablet (Media Home › Settings › Web remote).
html.hint.ytkey: Play first video uses YouTube's official search, which needs your own free YouTube API key (one time, about 5 minutes: see YouTube key in the manual). Paste it here; it is kept only on the tablet.
html.pad.help:
Move: one finger · Click: tap
Scroll: two fingers · Long press: hold
html.hint.input: Turn on Mouse & keyboard: on the tablet open Media Home › Settings › Set up › Mouse and keyboard from the phone and switch on Media Home remote mouse & keyboard.
html.hint.files: Allow All files access: on the tablet open Media Home › Settings › Set up › Music and files and switch it on for Media Home Pure.
html.hint.pp: Player Pure is not responding. Open it once on the tablet, then try again.
